baselines: existing fixed5 delay control from Economic Alpha DELAYS, no sweep
candidate: only after diagnosticGate; enter once at first positive predicted value at15/20/25, otherwise deliberate ABSTAIN at25; no retry after a missing fill
diagnostic: QUALIFY session-equal Spearman of prediction vs target, plus training-score quintile outcomes and positive-target frequency
economic: reference after-cost forward return; not full-day low prediction
labels: valid completed prefix + observed next OPEN and exact30 close; unknown labels excluded from FIT only and counted, not removed from original policy ledger

model.fitCount: one Entry diagnostic model; one EXIT diagnostic model on precommitted conditional Entry route; no refit after QUALIFY
model.objective: mean weighted squared error + alpha*sum(beta^2), intercept unpenalized
model.searchSpace: one fixed specification per component, no hyperparameter/threshold/horizon search
model.trigger: >0 predicted economic target; first positive state only; no tuning
model.weights: equal sessions then equal event identities then equal states within event

policyGate: after diagnosticGate replay QUALIFY, use identical original opportunity IDs and common30 evaluation mask. Both sides deliberate no-trade=0 economic value; unknown prices remain null. Mean trade net and opportunity net separately.
